scope: Personal close reading of all 55 songs: full source lyrics, English renderings, existing annotations and artist context. No delegated song reviews.
method: Read every source-language lyric and English rendering in sequence, with only adjacent identical repetitions collapsed in the reading packets.
Read every existing annotation, then revise the song overview and the interpretively important phrase notes.
Distinguish artist, guest and dramatized speakers; track returns, reversals, endings and cross-song connections.
Use artist interviews as context without treating his other projects or unnamed disputes as explanations of particular lines.
Retain useful language/reference notes and their sources. Interpretations are editorial close readings, not artist-confirmed statements.

contextReadThisPass.use: Artist on mixtape composition, autonomy and resistance to being made a representative figure.
Artist on everyday sources, process and collaboration; not a track-by-track explanation of this release.
Distinguish statements about another project from the present album; naturalness and persona.

keyCorrections: Doge returns to pressure and its unanswered question after the musical outlet.
Oleander offers permission to leave mid-song, then returns to one-sided attachment.
Sweet continues after the lonely-people refrain into audience pressure and the wish for ignorance.
Guest verses retain their own speakers, especially on Mold Prize, Macaron, Life Life Life and Ghost Dog.
